name: A2A Agent Evaluation
description: Evaluates the A2A-enabled grocery retail assistant deployed on Agent Engine. Tests SOP lookup, brand guidelines, analytics delegation, and image generation via the A2A protocol wrapper.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: What are the store opening procedures for morning shift associates?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: After receiving the SOP information, ask about the required PPE for the produce section. Then ask what happens if a safety violation is observed during the opening check.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: What are our brand typography and font guidelines?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: After getting typography info, ask about the approved color palette for in-store signage. Then ask about tone of voice guidelines for social media posts.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Which store has the highest total revenue?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: After seeing the results, ask about the top 3 product categories by sales volume. Then ask how Gold tier loyalty customers compare to Bronze tier in average transaction value.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: I need to prepare a promotional display. What are our brand color guidelines and what are the top selling products I should feature?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: After getting both brand colors and product data, ask for an image of the top-selling product styled with our brand colors. Verify the agent coordinates across SOP search, analytics, and image generation.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Hello, what capabilities do you have?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to demonstrate one capability at a time. Start with SOP lookup, then analytics. Confirm it mentions all four skill areas: SOPs, brand guidelines, analytics, and image generation.
